_comment: What the rules in quest/grammar/Pronunciation cannot know from the spelling (WP3.8/4.4). overrides: whole word, pron without brackets, rule ids. nInsertion: bar before the second part of a compound that gets an inserted ㄴ. linked: bar before a vowel-initial second part that counts as a word of its own, so the first final is neutralised and carried over. tenseJoin: bar before a second part that is tensed (사이시옷 words). stems: verb stems in ㄴ/ㅁ whose dictionary form is tensed (신다 -> 신따). sinoWords: Sino-Korean words inside a phrase, whose own origin the phrase tag does not show (the ㄹ + ㄷ/ㅅ/ㅈ rule applies per word; a trailing * means only inside a longer phrase, so 갈색 alone keeps its tag). Keep it small; the forms follow the 표준 발음법 and are checked in the native review.
